name: Tree House Education & Accessories Limited
about: Tree House Education & Accessories Limited provides educational and related services to K-12 schools in India. The company offers pre-primary education and education support services; and a range of programs, including play group, nursery, junior kindergarten, senior kindergarten, summer camp, teacher's training courses, hobby class, and day care services, as well as life skills programs and consultancy services. It also engages in the operation of preschools; leasing of education infrastructure; and franchise of education centers. The company caters to mid-to high-income parents in metropolitan areas or cities. Tree House Education & Accessories Limited was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Mumbai, India.
